title: Product page, universal skeleton
when: Every default product page; start here when no product recipe fits.
evidence: the similar-products shelf on about 2 in 5 default product pages, recently viewed on about 2 in 3, the subscription last on about 3 in 4; the median tail under the card is 4 sections

steps.note: Its typography is that of `pdp-quiet-title-firm-price`. `pdp-edge-to-edge-gallery` for image-led brands with 6 or more consistent photos.
Catalogs of 8 or more products. Smaller catalogs: a curated collection of other formats (`two-column-formats`) instead, since similar products stay empty or repeat the product.
One store-specific chapter from the merchant: care, warranty, returns or usage. Or ImageWithText `brand-story-split` for a material or brand story.
Last shelf: never the only one, never the first under the card.

The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one.

notes: On phones keep at most 3 blocks under the product card: the similar shelf, recently viewed and one chapter. Never copy home story grids under the product.

Name and price on the first phone screen: `pdp-classic-2col` already sets the quiet title and firm price of `pdp-quiet-title-firm-price`; if you pick another card preset, merge `pdp-quiet-title-firm-price` over it when names run past about 40 characters or photos are 3:4. Keep one header row (`header-touch-one-row` stacked over the header's archetype) and no announcement bar on this page.

Before publishing, preview the product page: no «we do not deliver to this city» line (else `pdp-modules-prelaunch`), advantages only confirmed policies, no technical names in the chips. See references/product-page.md.
